scope: Exact-head PR comparison: native1148 plus latest Lightpanda nightly11471 and the renderer readiness/diagnostic fix; all nine actors, three alternating pairs per architecture/workload. Production native source6b19 and renderer source9c40 have this runtime contract and the corresponding reviewed renderer code.

native.scope: Protected read-only ADR006 post-renderer-recovery attestation: actual active pointer, env/success/manifest, immutable image/VERSION, running/healthy core services and selected canonical counts. No writes, restarts, sync, repair, hold changes or forced work.

renderer.scope: Independent protected read-only installed source/image/active-marker/verifier/actual browser digest, listener, network, unchanged PKI and cgroup/budget inspection. No browser launch, origin requests, network reconcile or production mutation.

conservation.scope: Atomic bounded Redis observation for canonical enabled monitors; source-bound read-only SQL/Redis. IDs/URLs stay in RAM; token values never read, only HEXISTS booleans before output. No claims, repairs or origin work.

readback_limits: Independent time-bound readbacks, not a universal fleet freshness claim. Later company publications may advance the data generation. Historical downstream/R2/natural enrichment and cold-reversal observations remain dated in the plan.
